name: NGC 1943 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 1943, a star cluster in the Large Magellanic Cloud, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc1943-hubble
story: A compact gathering of young stars in the Large Magellanic Cloud, home to pulsating Cepheid variables whose rhythm has been used to clock the cluster's age.

claims.text: NGC 1943 is a blue concentrated cluster in the Large Magellanic Cloud
Also known as SL 430 and ESO 56-SC 114
Its age was determined from the pulsation periods of its Cepheids
